platform: desktop (LibreOffice Writer 26.2 on Fedora 44, GNOME Wayland)
description: Writer's Insert, Format and Styles menus sometimes do not open or open briefly and close by themselves.
expected_report: In an empty Writer document the user clicks Insert, Format and Styles in the menu bar. Expected: the clicked menu stays open. Actual: those menus fail to open or flash open and close immediately, while other menus (Edit, File) open normally. Reproduces in safe mode and with a reset profile.
difficulty: The bug is an absence or a sub-second flash of a menu; dark theme UI chrome; a screen-recorder timer in the top bar; working menus act as a control.
